response.overview: Lady, beautiful daughter of a rich man, is bad at business because she loves beauty and does not persevere. When Lady wants to open a store to sell brand name items from abroad, her father suggests that she go to Ban Na Hing Hoy to complete the “Strong, Big, Long” mission that will bring Lady enough funds to open her shop. On her way she meets Phoupha, a hard-working, self-sufficient farmer who guides Lady in completing the “mission.” As their warm feelings for each other blossom into love, the must confront, and overcome, obstacles from many sides.
response.title: I Love You!
